execution_policy: After completing the intended implementation, run each module once. Reuse existing valid results; do not repeat module tests for separate languages, scales or broad regressions. Preserve uncovered scenarios as unverified rather than passed.
required_coverage: Reuse a current verified four-language hot-switch test for every effect, host, community and shared controls. Do not launch repeated module runs to fill cold-start or scale matrices. Keep existing cold-start results and report remaining gaps explicitly.
preserved_requirements: At most 100 popup shows per batch
Catalog, deployment, identity and lifecycle verification
reporting: Record all manual acceptance as skipped by user, never as passed. Preserve automatic test failures and all runtime/cold-start/scale limitations; continue delivery without waiting for manual conclusions.
